sections.heading: Rekhā — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rekhā was born on 10 October 1954 in Chennai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Gemini Ganesan and her mother, Pushpavalli. She is a sibling of Kamala Selvaraj.
She is recorded as speaking Tamil and Telugu.

sections.heading: Rekhā — Career and Professional Work
paras: Rekhā works primarily as a politician, playback singer, musician and film actor.
Among the credits most often linked to Rekhā are Muqaddar Ka Sikandar, Khubsoorat, Silsila, Kalyug, Khoon Bhari Maang, Kama Sutra: A Tale of Love and Umrao Jaan.
She has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha. She is affiliated with independent politician.
